source_caption:
📺 All of Us (2003–2007)

All of Us follows Robert James, a successful television entertainment reporter navigating the challenges of raising his young son, Bobby, while maintaining a complicated relationship with his ex-wife, Neesee. As Robert attempts to build a new life with his fiancée, Tia, he struggles to balance his romantic relationship with his responsibilities as a father and the constant involvement of his former wife. Despite their disagreements and contrasting personalities, Robert and Neesee remain committed to providing a loving and supportive environment for their son. Alongside their friends and family, they experience hilarious misunderstandings, parenting challenges, romantic complications, and unexpected emotional moments. Starring Duane Martin, LisaRaye McCoy, Elise Neal, and Khamani Griffin, the series combines relatable comedy with heartfelt storytelling while exploring divorce, co-parenting, blended families, friendship, love, and the importance of putting children first, even when relationships don’t work out as planned.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Romance • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: Will Smith, Jada Pinkett Smith & Betsy Borns

📺 Seasons: 4 • 88 Episodes

📚 Inspired By: Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith’s experiences with blended family life.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: All of Us is an American sitcom that premiered on the UPN network in the United States on September 16, 2003, where it aired for its first three seasons. On October 1, 2006, the show moved to The CW, a new network formed by the merger of UPN and The WB (whose sister company Warner Bros. Television produced this series), where it aired for one more season before being cancelled on May 15, 2007.
